title: bench_core.stream_run takes a timeout and a clean env, and agent_bench keeps an error result's cost, usage and subtype
goal: bench_core.stream_run takes a timeout and a clean env and passes them to agent_bench.execute, which reports a timeout as a failure named timeout in place of its fixed 900 s; agent_bench.result_of keeps the cost, usage, model usage and subtype of an error result (error_max_turns, error_max_budget_usd); no new test id: the test_bench.py bundle gains a body that feeds agent_bench.execute a session that outlives its timeout and an error_max_budget_usd result.

run:
import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import agent_bench as a
line=json.dumps({'type':'result','subtype':'error_max_budget_usd','is_error':True,'total_cost_usd':8.01,'num_turns':40,'usage':{'input_tokens':5,'output_tokens':7},'modelUsage':{'claude-sonnet-5-5':{'costUSD':8.01}},'result':''})
r=a.result_of(line,'',12.0)
print(r); sys.exit(0 if r.get('cost')==8.01 and 'error_max_budget_usd' in json.dumps(r) else 1)
